workflows.description: Where guests and services find the workflows they name. source: local, the default, is this repository's workflows/ folder, where each workflow's version is the one its workflow.yaml declares. repository names a separate workflows repository, whose versions are its release tags <id>/v<M>.<m>; this repository then holds no workflows/ or modules/.

repository.description: The workflows repository: https://, ssh://, user@host:path, file:// or an absolute path.

credential.description: The store key of the credential to fetch it with: an HTTPS token or an SSH private key, by the repository's scheme. Without it, the lab repository's credential is used when the schemes match.
